The '''Loovria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Loovria/Legends|Loovria]].
